reviewer_role: Independent venue, references and disclosure audit; separate from candidate authoring
scope: Source-text and primary-source guideline/reference review; candidate main, supplement, bibliography, cover letter and decision memo. No training, test-set access, credential access, upload or submission. PDF layout was not visually audited by this agent.

checks.subject: Venue and format
checks.evidence: Bioinformatics official initial-submission page permits a single readable PDF and does not require templates initially; candidate is explicitly a review manuscript, not a production template. Original Paper is the defensible article-type candidate. No separate Analysis type was established. Application Note is not justified by this case-study contribution.

checks.subject: Guideline verification
checks.evidence: Official submission_online and homepage support format-free initial submission. Specific author-guideline provisions were checked through official indexed excerpts because full author-guidelines retrieval was blocked/oversized. Exact numeric abstract limit was not fully independently verified. GUIDELINES.json records this limitation; no universal journal-compliance certification is issued.

checks.subject: Main-reference metadata
checks.evidence: Nine focused references checked against primary publication pages and, where needed, public Crossref metadata. Witten is correctly a 2019 bioRxiv preprint; Kingma is the 2013 arXiv version; DBAASP print citation is 2021; new 2026 QMAP and Beierle works have verified publisher records.

checks.subject: DDPM mixed-version bibliographic entry
checks.prior_issue: Conference venue was previously mixed with the arXiv DOI.
checks.change: ho2020 now uses inproceedings, NeurIPS volume 33, pages 6840--6851, and official proceedings URL without arXiv DOI.

checks.subject: Standalone supplement MIC references
checks.prior_issue: Named MIC sources lacked self-contained formal references in the supplement.
checks.change: Supplement now includes Witten, QMAP and DBAASP references with DOI links.
checks.recheck: Confirmed title, author, year and DOI against verified reference ledger.

checks.subject: Citation support and novelty boundary
checks.evidence: Prior peptide RNN work supports established autoregressive lineage, not exact reproduction. HydrAMP/AMPGen support published generation-plus-assay workflows, not a guaranteed raw-generator hit rate. Beierle and QMAP prevent a first-observation or mature-benchmark claim. Source text retains the bounded development-case interpretation.

checks.subject: AI disclosure in Methods and cover letter
checks.evidence: Both disclose substantial AI assistance with code, execution/analysis, source checking, drafting and technical audit. Separate agents are not represented as human peer review. Exact historical model versions and complete prior-use history remain explicitly unresolved, as does human verification. Disclosure does not assert language editing only.

checks.subject: Cover-letter truthfulness
checks.evidence: Letter is labelled unsent/NO_GO, describes one-seed and reused-development-data limits, makes no unsupported original-model or general-superiority claim, and does not invent author approval, exclusivity or publication-readiness attestations.

checks.subject: Science and external validity
checks.evidence: One fitted seed, repeatedly reused development set, incomplete baseline optimization and realized-compute comparability, no independent H5 biological validation. Sequence validity and distances cannot establish efficacy. The current case does not establish the biological advance expected by Communications Biology.

checks.subject: Human authorship and publication declarations
checks.evidence: Author identities/affiliations/contact, contributions, funding, conflicts, related-work overlap, historical assay provenance, full AI-use history and release arrangements require responsible human verification. No approval or attestation was inferred.

remaining_blockers: Independent scientific-validity limitations recorded in V09.
Human factual verification and declarations recorded in V10.
Public release and full reproducibility arrangements remain unresolved.
action: Return complete documents for human and independent scientific review; do not submit.
